prayerExcerpt.en-US: "The soul that journeys in the light and the truths of the Faith is safe against all error."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "A alma que caminha na luz e nas verdades da Fé está a salvo de todo erro."

meta.face: A Phoenician of Tyre of about fifty-five with a warm, olive-bronze complexion and a WIDE, LOW, FLAT-CHEEKED face — a BROAD, low forehead, WIDE, flat cheek planes and a WIDE jaw, THICK, black brows ARCHED high and full, LARGE, dark, slightly PROMINENT eyes with a kind, direct look, a nose with a strong, gentle CURVE and a FLESHY, rounded tip, a FULL, wide mouth; thick, wavy black hair touched with grey at the temples, falling to the neck; a full, thick black beard, rounded at the bottom; the gaze warm and steady. Not the tall, egg-shaped anicetus, the round, soft severianus_scythopolis, the short, domed lucian_antioch or the Copts pachomius and macarius_alexandria.
meta.basis: The modern icon on English Wikipedia's page shows a dark-haired, full-bearded bishop; no likeness survives, so the card keeps the icon's colouring on a broad Levantine face, the boy of Tyre grown into the bishop the book says St. Athanasius ordained. Axum and its court are from the book and from Rufinus via Wikipedia.
